title: Mohd Suhel Live
description: Get ready for an evening of unapologetic laughs with Mohd. Suhel Live — a stand-up comedy show where Suhel dives into brutally honest takes on his life, his parents, his brother, and everything that makes family gatherings weirdly funny. From Mumbai versus Delhi banter to dark, deadpan humor and a few jokes that almost got him into trouble, Suhel brings it all with a straight face and razor-sharp timing.
